required_assets: Original continuous talking-head video with clear voice audio
optional_assets: Separate microphone recording, with a visible clap for synchronization if convenient
Relevant screen capture at original resolution
Preferred-take note or approximate mistake timestamps
recording.camera: Eye-level, head-and-shoulders framing, clean background, front-facing light
recording.voice: Clear dry speech; no baked-in music; no clipping
recording.mistakes: Pause 2–3 seconds, restart the full sentence, and continue recording

timeline.timing_basis: Provisional edited-program positions; align source cuts to actual narration
timeline.source_in_out_points: Unset until the recording is reviewed

cues: Open on the presenter for the introductory sentence
Insert slide-01 full screen at the first suitable phrase boundary
Reveal or highlight details only when the narration introduces them
If available and relevant, insert a readable demo within this interval
Use an optional demo only where it directly follows the narration
Keep detailed text and numbers readable; avoid motion while they are discussed
Return to the presenter for the closing sentence
Finish all words and the music fade before the silent end hold

duration_policy.overrun_action: Use a shorter spoken pickup or revise the cut; never force the target by cutting words

picture_plan.default_transition: Clean cut at a spoken phrase boundary

optional_crossfade.duration_accounting: Overlap inside the planned timeline; do not add runtime

picture_plan.motion: Restrained reveals and highlights; no continuous zooming or decorative effects

presenter.overlay_rule: Use only empty slide space; omit the inset if it covers content or captions

picture_plan.demo_policy: Optional inserts replace part of a slide interval; all six slides still appear full screen

captioned_slide_layout.rule: Scale the full slide uniformly into this presentation area; reserve the bottom band for captions and preserve every slide footnote. Check two-line captions fit the band.

picture_plan.clean_slide_layout: Use the native full-screen 1920×1080 slide; presenter inset only in unobstructed space.

audio_plan.processing: Correct sync, edit mistakes, and apply light cleanup only as needed for intelligibility

music.rights_policy: Original or properly licensed for the intended distribution
provenance_required: Source URL or original creation record
music.ducking_amount: Adjust to the actual voice and music so every word remains clear
music.fade_timing: Set after the narration edit; finish the fade by 175 seconds

initial_mix_targets.status: Starting targets, not measured results or guaranteed final settings
initial_mix_targets.verification: Listen for intelligibility and measure the final encoded export; adjust as needed

captions_policy.alignment: Realign to edited audio after picture and narration cuts settle
captions_policy.manual_review: Check technical names, numbers, punctuation, and every caption boundary
captions_policy.layout: Readable text in safe margins, normally no more than two lines
captions_policy.captioned_master: Burn in the reviewed aligned captions

export_targets.final_review: Check timing, voice clarity, slide readability, caption sync, and the complete silent end hold
